text.en:
The Isabela high School in the Municipality of Ilagan, Province of Isabela, is hereby converted
into a national high school to be known as the Isabela National High School.

The Ministry of Education and Culture shall take the necessary steps for the immediate
implementation of this Act.

The amount of two hundred thousand pesos for the operation of the school shall be charged to
the appropriations authorized by Batas Pambansa Blg. 80 for the Ministry of Education and Culture intended
for new national schools.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: February 8, 1982
